Global (All).title: Russia-Ukraine conflict escalates, NATO warns of 'unprecedented' consequences
Global (All).summary: The conflict between Russia and Ukraine has intensified, with NATO warning of 'unprecedented' consequences for global stability. The US and EU have imposed new sanctions on Russia, while Ukraine's military says it has made gains in the east.

Global (All).title: US-China tensions rise over Taiwan
Global (All).summary: The US and China have clashed over Taiwan, with the US conducting military exercises in the South China Sea. China has warned the US to stay out of its 'internal affairs', while the US has pledged to defend Taiwan.

Global (All).title: COVID-19 cases surge in Indonesia and Malaysia
Global (All).summary: COVID-19 cases have surged in Indonesia and Malaysia, with both countries imposing new restrictions to slow the spread of the virus. The outbreaks have raised concerns about the effectiveness of vaccination campaigns in Southeast Asia.

United States.summary: Florida lawmakers propose new bill to address rising crime in the state, focusing on repeat offenders and violent crimes.

US President Joe Biden calls for increased action to address the gun violence crisis in the US, amid the anniversary of the 1999 Columbine High School shooting and recent mass shootings in California and Texas.

The US Supreme Court allows the House January 6 committee to access classified documents related to the investigation into the 2021 US Capitol attack, potentially shedding new light on the January 6 insurrection.

South Korea.title: Seoul's Mayor Suspended Amidst Corruption Probe
South Korea.summary: The suspension of Seoul's mayor amidst a corruption probe has sparked concerns about the integrity of the city's governance. This development may impact investor confidence and public trust in the government, contributing to a medium-level risk scenario.

South Korea.title: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missiles, Raising Tensions
South Korea.summary: North Korea has fired multiple ballistic missiles, escalating tensions with South Korea and international powers. This aggression poses a significant risk to regional stability and global security, warranting a high-level risk assessment.

South Korea.title: South Korean Trade Minister Resigns Amidst Beef Import Dispute
South Korea.summary: The South Korean trade minister has resigned due to controversy surrounding the country's decision to import US beef. This development may impact trade relations with key partners and contribute to market volatility, resulting in a medium-level risk scenario.

Japan.title: Protests Held Against Changes to Japan's Voting Rights Law
Japan.summary: Thousands of Japanese citizens protested the amendments to the voting rights law, fearing it would make it more difficult for certain groups to participate in the country's electoral process.

Japan.title: Cybercrime Attacks on Japanese Companies Increases
Japan.summary: Several major Japanese companies have been targeted in a series of high-profile cybercrime attacks in the last week, resulting in significant economic losses.

Japan.title: Rising Tensions Between Japan and China over Taiwan
Japan.summary: Tensions have escalated between Japan and China over Taiwan, with both nations engaging in a war of words in the media, and there have been reports of military mobilization in the region.
